sections.heading: What is Banking?
sections.text: Banking involves managing money through financial institutions.

sections.heading: Types of Accounts
sections.text:
- Savings account
- Current account
- Fixed deposits
- Recurring deposits

sections.heading: Services
sections.text:
- Deposits
- Loans
- Digital payments
- Investment services

sections.heading: Types of Institutions
sections.text:
- Commercial banks
- Cooperative banks
- Credit unions
- NBFCs

sections.heading: Credit Union vs Bank
sections.text:
Credit unions are member-owned.
Banks are profit-driven institutions.

sections.heading: Deposit Safety
sections.text: Deposits are insured up to ₹5,00,000 in India.

sections.heading: Choosing a Bank
sections.text: Consider interest rates, fees, accessibility, and security.
